body.name: regular recursive plug-in estimator
body.construction: Compute \((\widehat B,\widehat Q)\) from \((\widehat M_0,\widehat M_1)\), apply the unique odd graph-recursive root map, recover diagonal \(D\) recursively, and set \(\widehat h_{uv}(z)=\widehat A_{vu}z/(1-\widehat A_{vv}z)\) for \(z\in\mathcal Z\).
